Watch out for sentences starting with "There", where the noun after the verb decides the form, and for phrases like "together with" or "as well as", which usually do not change the subject. For instance, "The manager, together with her team, is in the meeting."

Your task: write two sentences of your own, one beginning with "There" and one using "as well as". Afterwards, explain briefly why each verb form is correct.
